name: dsh-ssh-ops
description: SSH ops and database tools for DSH Web UI: connect to remote servers via SSH terminal/SFTP/tunnels, and connect to MySQL/PostgreSQL/Redis/MongoDB databases. Host half manages sessions with ssh2; client half renders the terminal and database panel.

scripts.build: node scripts/gen-xterm-css.mjs && node scripts/build-host.mjs && node scripts/build-client.mjs
scripts.test: node --test test/safety.mjs test/db-safety.mjs test/db-ops.mjs test/db-hang.mjs test/ssh-legacy-kex.mjs test/ssh-banner.mjs test/hostkey.mjs test/batch.mjs test/scp.mjs test/command-snippets.mjs test/ssh-panel-command-picker.mjs test/client.mjs test/manifest.mjs test/ssh-write.mjs test/credentials.mjs test/sftp-tools.mjs test/stream-file-routes.mjs test/manual-terminal-context.mjs test/terminal-stream.mjs test/exec-cwd.mjs test/terminal-pool.mjs test/terminal-theme.mjs test/pane-selection.mjs test/profile-connection.mjs test/active-connection.mjs test/sidebar-integration.mjs test/sidebar-lifecycle.mjs test/review-regressions.mjs test/project-directory.mjs test/resource-group-collapse.mjs test/resource-card-layout.mjs
